args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

The docstring already specified banker's rounding per FIN-212, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to
fail in the nightly build. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using ROUND_HALF_UP.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: switched the quantize rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the docstring and FIN-212.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding` (commit 08d3cd5986) passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
